skin.setting: a night sleeper train crossing the Carpathians, 1931
skin.title: The Carpathian Sleeper
skin.place: Aboard the Trans-Balkan Express winding through the snowbound Carpathian Mountains
skin.styleGuide: Moody gouache and ink illustrations evoking European noir with frosty blue shadows, warm mahogany tones, and diffuse amber lamplight.

rooms.name: the Corridor
rooms.description: A long, narrow passage lined with frosted glass windows and polished brass handrails.

rooms.name: the Dining Saloon
rooms.description: A lavish dining car dressed in white linen, heavy burgundy drapery, and silver plate.

rooms.name: the Observation Lounge
rooms.description: A plush sitting parlor at the end of the coach with panoramic windows overlooking the peaks.

rooms.name: the Stateroom
rooms.description: A private luxury sleeping compartment with velvet upholstery and walnut panelling.

rooms.name: the Luggage Van
rooms.description: A chilly, utilitarian freight section stacked with heavy leather trunks and crates.

people.name: Baroness Elena Vane
people.bio: A poised aristocrat traveling south to settle her late husband's estate. Her calm exterior masks the financial desperation threatening to strip away her family title.
people.voice: Speaks with icy, measured aristocracy and an unwavering gaze.
people.motive: Anton Varga held forged promissory notes that threatened to bankrupt her estate and ruin her social standing.
people.portrait: A tall, sharp-featured woman in her late forties with raven hair swept into an elegant chignon, dressed in a high-collared black silk traveling gown, standing with regal poise and empty hands.

people.name: Captain Mihail Radu
people.bio: A veteran railway officer with twenty years of service along the mountain lines. He runs his sleeper cars with military discipline and tolerates no disruption among the passengers.
people.voice: Speaks in brisk, gravelly sentences with formal military precision.
people.motive: Anton Varga had discovered Radu was smuggling contraband across the border and planned to report him to the railway authorities.
people.portrait: A broad-shouldered man in his fifties with a graying mustache, wearing a crisp dark navy railway conductor uniform with silver buttons, standing rigid with empty hands at his sides.

people.name: Dr. Lucian Grigorescu
people.bio: A quiet museum scholar known for cataloguing rare Byzantine relics. His academic career has recently been overshadowed by bitter disputes with private art dealers.
people.voice: Speaks softly and methodically, choosing each word with clinical deliberation.
people.motive: Anton Varga acquired an ancient illuminated manuscript stolen from Grigorescu's university and refused to return it.
people.portrait: A slender, middle-aged man with thinning brown hair, wire-rimmed spectacles perched on a narrow nose, wearing a brown tweed suit with a woolen waistcoat, standing motionless with empty hands.

people.name: Nadia Zima
people.bio: A celebrated performer en route to a winter residency in Bucharest. Beneath her glamorous stage persona lies a woman fighting to reclaim her independence.
people.voice: Speaks with a smoky, theatrical cadence and subtle irony.
people.motive: Anton Varga had locked her into an exploitative management contract that drained all earnings from her performances.
people.portrait: A young woman with wavy auburn hair cut in a stylish bob, wearing a midnight-blue velvet evening coat with a soft fox collar, standing gracefully with empty hands.

people.name: Anton Varga
people.bio: A ruthless broker of rarities and secrets who made enemies across every capital in Europe. His lavish tastes were funded entirely by leverage and extortion.
people.voice: Speaks with mocking charm and predatory confidence.
people.portrait: A stout, middle-aged man with slicked dark hair, heavy jowls, and a dark wool suit with satin lapels, sitting slumped motionless with empty hands.

skin.briefing: As the Trans-Balkan Express plows through a blinding blizzard high in the Carpathian Mountains, the train is brought to a sudden halt by snowdrifts. In the private Stateroom, art dealer Anton Varga is discovered dead, having met a violent end between 11:00 PM and 1:00 AM. With the carriage sealed against the freezing gale and only four other souls aboard this coach, one of the travelers is certainly the killer. Examine their movements, account for their whereabouts, and uncover the truth before the tracks are cleared.
skin.scene: A vintage railway sleeper car stranded in a snowy mountain pass at night, with frost-rimmed windows, glowing brass lamps, and heavy mahogany paneling under a starless winter sky.
skin.summingUp:
The diffuse lamplight in this train carriage reveals the timeline with cold clarity. First, Card 1 narrows down when the murder happened, proving that the strike did not occur at 10:00 PM or 2:00 AM.

Next, Card 2 puts the two of them in one room, meaning Anton Varga must have been in the Stateroom at Midnight. Because Card 2 places Anton Varga in company at that hour, he was still alive, establishing that the murder was not at 11:00 PM or Midnight. The crime could only have taken place at 1:00 AM.

Finally, because the killer and Anton Varga were both in the Stateroom when it happened, Baroness Elena Vane, Dr. Lucian Grigorescu, and Nadia Zima are entirely in the clear. That leaves only Captain Mihail Radu. Anton Varga had discovered Radu was smuggling contraband across the border and planned to report him to the railway authorities, giving Radu the sole motive and opportunity to kill him in the Stateroom at 1:00 AM.
